title: Tomato Ketchup - Heirloom
preamble:
Makes Large Quantity.

Peel 4 quarts tomatoes

2 quarts vinegar

6 chopped red peppers

4 tablespoons salt
method: Place all ingredients in a kettle
Bottle, seal, and serve as a condiment for meat and fish.
